title: Molecular Profiling to Predict Response to Treatment - Wilms Tumor

evidence.locator: computed from 52 cases; follow-up time derivable for 13 of them

access.typical_turnaround: days to a few weeks after signing official approval
access.citation_requirement: Cite the dataset accession and the program's publication guidelines; see the GDC publication policy.
access.license: NIH Genomic Data Sharing Policy terms

primary_publications.title: Genetic changes associated with relapse in favorable histology Wilms tumor: A Children's Oncology Group AREN03B2 study.

evidence.locator: earliest highly cited article analyzing MP2PRT-WT (published 2022)
evidence.note: Inferred, not authoritative. The source repository does not publish a marker-paper link for this dataset, so we nominate the earliest heavily cited article that analyzed it. Flagged for expert review before being relied on.

publication.title: Three-Dimensional Epigenome Roadmap of Human B-cell Differentiation Uncovers Mechanisms of Humoral Immunity and Oncogenesis

evidence.note: Search strategy epmc-sectioned-v1. Section placement is used to grade the strength of reuse evidence, not merely to confirm a citation.
Index strategy epmc-index-v1. Every dataset is measured with the same fields so the counts are comparable; per-tier value is the maximum across that tier's fields and across the dataset's accessions.
Availability dated from the literature (epmc-first-reference-v2) rather than from repository file timestamps, which record re-harmonization. This is a lower bound on availability.

basis: 1 article(s) reference this dataset's accession in a methods or results section, against 7.7 predicted for datasets of comparable size, age, modality breadth and access tier (reuse gap index -2.12 on a log2 scale, 8th percentile of the assessed corpus).
Its publications are cited 27 times, about 27 citations for every article that analyzed the data - the dataset is known but little used.
underexplored.comparator_set: 132 datasets in this corpus with a citable accession and sufficient metadata

evidence.locator: Huber robust regression of log2(analyzing articles + 1) on cohort size, years available, modality breadth and access tier
evidence.note: Model, covariates and coefficients are published with the dataset export so the label can be recomputed or contested.
